body.description: 57 Carmelita Street Illegal Short-Term Rentals by Owner for one (1) bedroom possible unpermitted dwelling unit on Airbnb https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/792370 https://www.airbnb.com/users/show/278835. Airbnb instructed to cancel any reservations for stays of less than 30 days. Appears activity ceased. Short-Term Rental Violation Abated CLOSED

The current basement level is to be lowered by 2'-4.5" to accommodate a garage and areas with ceiling heights of min 7'-6". A ramp to the garage flanked by planters and steps will replace the current front yard raised planter area. The rear of the house is to be remodeled with a new attached garden room at the North portion of the rear which replaces the current attached garden room located at the center of the rear.  New windows at the rear facade are also planned. Interior remodel as shown on drawing set on all levels. We understand a Certificate of Appropriateness is required for the garage level work but not the rear garden room or windows as confirmed by SF Planning.
